class.name: AudioStreamPlaybackSynchronized
class.description: Playback component of [AudioStreamSynchronized]. Handles the playback of multiple [AudioStream]s in synchrony.

method.name: get_playback
method.description: Returns the playback of a sub-stream, by index. Note that the reference can go stale, for example if [method AudioStreamSynchronized.set_sync_stream] is called.
